_metadata.description: Universal structure checks plus lifecycle-wiring reconcile rules: freshness-check presence, production-serving conformance, and dependency well-formedness.

requirements.title: Validate scenario skeleton invariants
requirements.description: The validator flags missing/invalid service.json, a service.name that does not match the directory, and missing required top-level files or per-surface directories; a conformant scenario produces no structural findings.

validation.notes: rules/rules_test.go covers the conformant-clean, service.json-missing, and service-name-mismatch cases.

requirements.title: Flag missing per-surface freshness checks
requirements.description: Each buildable surface must declare a well-formed freshness check (binaries / ui-bundle); a missing or malformed check is a finding, closing the silent-rebuild gap where a scenario rebuilds on every start.

validation.notes: rules/rules_test.go asserts a buildable surface without a freshness check emits FRESHNESS_CHECK_MISSING.

requirements.title: Require a complete lifecycle-wiring chain
requirements.description: Each declared surface must have a build(setup)→start(develop)→port/env→health-check chain; a missing health check or lifecycle step in that chain is a finding.

validation.notes: rules/rules_test.go asserts a surface without a health check emits HEALTH_CHECK_MISSING.

requirements.title: Enforce production-serving conformance
requirements.description: A UI surface's develop step must serve the built production bundle (NODE_ENV=production, conditioned on dist) rather than a dev server, preserving the hashed-asset caching guarantee; a dev-server develop step is a finding.

validation.notes: rules/rules_test.go asserts a dev-server UI develop step emits PRODUCTION_SERVE_NONCONFORMANT.

requirements.title: Reconcile declared-vs-actual surfaces
requirements.description: A surface declared in service.json with no actual implementation (and the reverse) emits a reconcile-mismatch finding so dangling or undeclared surfaces are caught.

validation.notes: rules/rules_test.go asserts a declared-not-actual surface emits SURFACE_RECONCILE_MISMATCH.

requirements.title: Validate dependency declarations
requirements.description: Dependency declarations must be well-formed (valid startup_policy/freshness_policy, resolvable, acyclic); an invalid policy or unresolved/cyclic dependency is a finding.

validation.notes: rules/rules_test.go asserts an invalid dependency policy emits DEPENDENCY_DECLARATION_INVALID.
